about.title: About Clinic Name
about.intro: Clinic Name was founded to close the gap between two cities we call home. Patients living between Cairo and Dubai told us the same thing: they wanted one clinic they could trust in both places, not two separate experiences.
about.missionBody: We believe good care starts with being heard. Every consultation is built around listening first, explaining clearly, and agreeing on next steps together — in whichever language you're most comfortable in.

values.title: Clarity
values.body: No jargon left unexplained. You should always know what's happening and why.

values.title: Continuity
values.body: Your records and history move with you between our locations.

values.title: Respect for time
values.body: Appointments run on schedule, and consultations aren't rushed.
